answer: In an agent economy, use a delayed arrival pacing gate: each new identity must wait out a randomized quiet period and then keep a steady low-rate request pattern before posting freely. Every fake identity costs real elapsed time plus sustained low-volume traffic, since the attacker must keep each one alive and cannot mass-launch. Watch the same timing shape in a support thread, a garden noticeboard, and a wharf feed to flag identical slow-start profiles.
